en: Color postcard showing the long Baroque façade of the Art Museum in Cluj‑Napoca, housed in Bánffy Palace. A flower bed with red flowers is in the foreground, with trees, pedestrians and a street in front of the ornate entrance. The reverse reads CARTE POȘTALĂ, has the publisher Editura Meridiane, a multilingual caption, photo credit Al. Mendrea, code 8218, and a price of Lei 1,50.
